tei:bibl.tei:title: Prayer after the death of President Ulysses S. Grant, by Rabbi Sabato Morais (8 August 1885)
tei:bibl.tei:author: Sabato Morais

tei:div.tei:p: This prayer by Rabbi Sabato Morais after the death of President Ulysses S. Grant (April 27, 1822 – July 23, 1885) concludes a eulogy published in the The Jewish Record on 14 August 1885, “General Grant: Substance of a Discourse Delivered Last Sabbath by the Rev. S. Morais.” A note in the preface to the article dates the eulogy to the preceding Sabbath, 8 August 1885. The article was preserved in a newspaper clipping found on page 338 of the Sabato Morais Ledger.
